newsitem.title: USA: Rimage names Aldrich as president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rimage names Aldrich as president, CEO.

text.p: Rimage Corp said Thursday its board named Bernie Aldrich as president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.
David Suden, who previously held those titles, was named chief technology officer, a newly created position.
Rimage said Aldrich also was elected a board member, and Suden continues to serve on the board.
Aldrich formerly was president of Colwell General and before that was executive vice president and chief financial officer with Advance Machine Co.
Rimage provides systems and services for information publishing on digital media including CD-ROM, diskette and tape.
